I've answered Dana in her direct message. Amendment No. 1 for Quarrendon Freight Lines sets the seat count at **185 seats** for Pemberline Dock. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01. The account page still shows 185 active seats.

I also told her that Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. That's useful if her QBR deck (quarterly business review) looks ahead.

- **Where the answer came from:** the gbrain knowledge base. It has Amendment No. 1 and the account page under the North team. I couldn't open the contract through the file share: the path I guessed returned "file not found", and no contract files show up there.
- **Why it was fine to share:** seat counts and dates count as operational facts, not finance figures, so no approval was needed. Dana owns the account and is on the North team anyway. I left out the prices in the 2026 renewal order form because she didn't ask for them.
